description: Defines an interface StreamInterface for stream objects, describing methods for reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving stream metadata, as well as managing stream resources within the Psr\Http\Message namespace.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, seeking to the beginning before reading.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and any underlying resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Separates the underlying resource from the stream, leaving it in an unusable state after detachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known, or null if unknown.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the read/write pointer in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Indicates if the stream cursor is at the end of the stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Determines if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the stream pointer to a specified offset based on the whence parameter.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks the stream to its beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream and returns the number of bytes written.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining content from the current position to the end of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata as an array or a specific key.
